verdicts.reason: Both reflow the headline into the same five-line stack with awkward breaks ('and a' / 'little' left as near-orphans) and the headline runs almost to the side edges. A's 'Now in four flavours' subline is shrunk to small, hard-to-read text and floats in a large dead gap below the headline. B keeps the subline and CTA at legible sizes, but its pill is almost full-width and crowds the bottom edge with a tight margin. B is slightly better because its secondary copy stays readable.
